# GATEWAY

> Every page of the GATEWAY module of the ABDM Developer Portal, fetchable as markdown.

## Pages

- [Gateway session](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-9/docs/hiecm/v3/api/gateway): Every ABDM call carries a bearer token from one endpoint. This is that endpoint, plus the certificate and bridge registration calls that sit beside it.
- [Find Bridge Service by Service ID](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-9/docs/hiecm/v3/api/gateway/endpoints/gateway-get-bridge-service-by-id): Look up a specific registered HIP/HIU service by its service ID.
- [Get Gateway JWKS Certificates](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-9/docs/hiecm/v3/api/gateway/endpoints/gateway-get-gateway-certs): Get the JSON Web Key Set (JWKS) to verify JWT signatures in gateway callbacks.
- [Get OIDC Discovery Document](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-9/docs/hiecm/v3/api/gateway/endpoints/gateway-get-oidc-config): OIDC discovery endpoint for the ABDM Gateway.
- [Get a provider by id](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-9/docs/hiecm/v3/api/gateway/endpoints/gateway-get-provider-by-id): Look up one provider by its provider id.
- [List All Bridge Services](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-9/docs/hiecm/v3/api/gateway/endpoints/gateway-list-bridge-services): List all HIP/HIU services registered under the authenticated bridge.
- [List government programs](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-9/docs/hiecm/v3/api/gateway/endpoints/gateway-list-govt-programs): List government programs registered with the gateway. The response
- [List health-locker-enabled providers](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-9/docs/hiecm/v3/api/gateway/endpoints/gateway-list-health-lockers): List providers with health locker functionality enabled, optionally
- [List providers by name](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-9/docs/hiecm/v3/api/gateway/endpoints/gateway-list-providers): List ABDM-registered providers, optionally filtered by name.
- [Register / Update Bridge Services (HIU)](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-9/docs/hiecm/v3/api/gateway/endpoints/gateway-register-bridge-services): Registers or updates one or more HIU service entries under a facility
- [Create a session and get an access token](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-9/docs/hiecm/v3/api/gateway/endpoints/gateway-sessions-create): Send the client id and client secret from your ABDM sandbox
- [Update HIP/HIU Bridge Callback URL](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-9/docs/hiecm/v3/api/gateway/endpoints/gateway-update-bridge-url): Register the HIP/HIU callback URL with the ABDM Gateway.
- [Gateway session errors](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-9/docs/hiecm/v3/api/gateway/errors): What Gateway session returns when a call fails, and what to do about it.
